The market before the market.

AfterOwn is designed to predict which physical assets are likely to become available for resale and privately match them with qualified buyers before the owner creates a public listing.

From latent supply to real transactions.

Traditional marketplaces wait for sellers to list. AfterOwn is designed to work earlier by connecting predicted future supply with standing buyer demand.

1
Register assetsBusinesses or owners connect or enter assets they already own.
2
Predict availabilityAfterOwn estimates which assets are likely to become surplus or replaced.
3
Match demandQualified buyers submit standing requirements and conditional bids.
4
Reveal the offerOwners receive a relevant offer without first creating a public listing.
5
Owner decidesThe owner can accept, reject or ignore. Nothing sells without consent.
6
Coordinate transferAccepted transactions can move into verification, pickup, payment and transfer.

One system. Two sides of the market.

For professional buyers

Declare what you want before it appears on the open market.

  • Standing purchase requirements
  • Future inventory visibility
  • Conditional pre-listing bids
  • Earlier access to supply

For asset owners

Discover demand without the friction of listing first.

  • Private matching
  • Relevant offers
  • Owner-controlled decisions
  • Potentially faster disposition

Starting with enterprise technology assets.

The initial pilot is designed around business laptops and standardized technology equipment, where model, age, condition, professional buyer demand and residual value are comparatively easy to verify. The same mechanism could later extend to machinery, hospitality equipment, laboratory assets, office furniture, robotics and other depreciating physical assets.
